info.name: Assinafy
info.summary: Send, sign and track Nextcloud PDF contracts
info.description:
Connect a Nextcloud account to Assinafy with OAuth 2.0 and send stored PDF files for signature.
Supported signature and notification methods include email, WhatsApp, biometric identity verification and ICP-Brasil A1/A3 digital certificates. Contract lifecycle tracking and webhook management are included.
Requires an Assinafy account. An administrator registers the Assinafy OAuth client once; each user then connects one Assinafy workspace.
**Data sent to Assinafy:** only when a user sends a document does the app upload the selected PDF and the recipients' names, email addresses, phone numbers and CPF/CNPJ to Assinafy (https://www.assinafy.com.br). Contract terms and webhook settings are sent when a user saves them. OAuth tokens stay encrypted on the Nextcloud server and never reach the browser.
